attempts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: ONE standalone rehabilitation exercise demonstration photograph, 4:5 portrait, full body.
Input images 1–3 are supporting references only: match this exact East Asian adult woman, her face, age, skin, proportions, black ponytail, plain white short-sleeved T-shirt and dark charcoal long straight trousers, photographic texture, soft studio light, cool muted gray-blue seamless background. Do not copy their raised-arm poses. Extend her clothing with plain unbranded white low-top athletic shoes.
Create step 141 T-AXU-019 s01, single-side suitcase carry preparation. She has already lifted the weight and now stands still naturally upright facing toward image-right along a clear level walking route. BOTH feet flat planted shoulder-width, knees natural. Her anatomical RIGHT hand, on the camera-facing side, firmly wraps the curved handle of exactly ONE small lightweight matte-black kettlebell hanging vertically close beside her right outer thigh, with several centimeters clearance from the trousers. Anatomical LEFT hand is EMPTY and relaxed by her far side, visibly empty. Both arms hang naturally. Level relaxed shoulders, neutral trunk, no side lean. Show realistic fingers wrapping the handle, right wrist neutral, no lifting swing.
Fixed set for all four frames: cool gray-blue floor continuous with backdrop, no floor markings; one stable dark charcoal rectangular placement platform with a light gray flat top at about 60–65 cm from floor sits toward image-right and slightly behind the walking route, fully in frame and clear of her feet. Platform has a solid stable base, no wheels, no lettering; large enough to set this small kettlebell on it. Kettlebell is in her right hand, NOT on platform in this frame.
Composition: fixed eye-level camera approximately true right-side profile with a slight forward angle so her right hand and both feet are clear. Full head, both complete hands, both complete shoes, entire kettlebell and entire platform in frame, generous margins. Woman occupies about 72 percent of image height, platform about 28 percent height, natural proportions. Soft floor shadows, clean restrained clinical demonstration studio photography, detailed skin and cloth, realistic anatomy. This is ONE pose in ONE photograph. No labels, no numbers, no arrows, no text, no logos, no watermark, no collage, no inset, no border.
attempts.status: calling cell cancelled after approximately ten minutes without output; not proof that backend generation failed

limitations: 四张为独立静态姿势图；小步调整的完整时间过程和实际负荷不能由静态照片证明。
生成图非真实摄影记录；视觉验收确认画面姿势和器械接触，未进行临床动作有效性认证。
固定机位与平台外观、位置保持同组一致；s04因人物走到后方台旁，人物投影尺度略减小；平台边缘存在约10像素生成差异。
平台高度是根据相对人体比例与放置姿势作图，不是测量结果。
tooling_notes: s01首次调用等待约10分钟后取消无输出的exec cell；取消不是后端失败证明。随后重建已丢失的store变量，首次重试脚本在调用工具前因undefined停止，修正后相同工具参数重试成功。
s03首次调用返回明确network error: error sending request；相同提示与参考重试成功。
未覆盖现有单图、其他进度JSON或任何仓库文件；默认generated_images源图保留。
